response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web engineer, but the role requires native-level Japanese, deep C-based UNIX/Linux kernel development, and embedded LAN-switch security expertise (MACsec, 802.1X, L2/L3 networking) — none of which are evidenced. His C/C++ experience is limited and dated (2014–2015), his languages are English, Romanian, and German, and his career trajectory centers on TypeScript/Node.js web platforms rather than embedded networking firmware.
strengths: Broad, long-tenured software engineering experience across web, mobile, and some low-level work
Some C/C++ and Linux exposure (National Instruments, low-latency DLang services, audio server thesis)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions, and knowledge sharing
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency — a hard requirement for this role
No embedded networking, switch, or security-feature experience (MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP, NETCONF)
C for UNIX and Linux kernel modification experience is minimal and roughly a decade old
